senses.definition_vi: các con số cho biết bạn sẽ nhận được bao nhiêu tiền nếu con ngựa bạn đặt cược thắng cuộc đua.

senses.definition: whatever the cost or the difficulties may be

examples.x: We want peace at any price.

senses.definition_vi: bất kể chi phí hoặc khó khăn là gì.

senses.definition: costing a lot of money

examples.x: You can buy strawberries all year round, but at a price.
Food is available, at a price.

senses.definition_vi: có giá nhiều tiền.

senses.definition: involving something unpleasant

examples.x: He'll help you—at a price!

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến điều gì đó khó chịu.

senses.definition: extremely valuable or important
senses.definition_vi: cực kỳ có giá trị hoặc quan trọng.

senses.definition: so good or useful that the cost does not seem too much

examples.x: To buy all the recommended equipment is expensive, but as an investment for the future it is cheap at the price.

senses.definition_vi: quá tốt hoặc hữu ích đến nỗi chi phí dường như không quá nhiều.

senses.definition: you can persuade anyone to do something by giving them more money or something that they want
senses.definition_vi: bạn có thể thuyết phục bất kỳ ai làm điều gì đó bằng cách cho họ nhiều tiền hơn hoặc thứ gì đó họ muốn.

senses.definition: used to say that no amount of money would persuade you to do or to sell something

examples.x: I wouldn't work for her again—not at any price!

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng không có số tiền nào có thể thuyết phục bạn làm hoặc bán một thứ gì đó.

senses.definition: to suffer because of bad luck, a mistake or something you have done

examples.x: He looked terrible this morning. I think he's paying the penalty for all those late nights.
They're now paying the price for past mistakes.
She thinks that any inconvenience is a price worth paying for living in such a beautiful place.

senses.definition_vi: chịu đựng vì vận rủi, một sai lầm hoặc điều gì đó bạn đã làm.

senses.definition: an amount of money that is offered for capturing or killing somebody

examples.x: Ever since he killed the gang’s leader, there has been a price on his head.

senses.definition_vi: một số tiền được đưa ra để bắt hoặc giết ai đó.

senses.definition: to say how much money something valuable is worth

examples.x: They haven't yet put a price on the business.
You can't put a price on that sort of loyalty.
You can't put a price on happiness.

senses.definition_vi: nói ra số tiền mà một thứ có giá trị đáng giá bao nhiêu.

senses.definition: used to say that you think that something you have achieved may not be worth all the problems and difficulties it causes

examples.x: What price fame and fortune?

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng bạn nghĩ rằng điều gì đó bạn đã đạt được có thể không đáng với tất cả những vấn đề và khó khăn mà nó gây ra.

senses.definition: used to say that something seems unlikely

examples.x: What price England winning the World Cup?

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó có vẻ khó xảy ra.

senses.definition: the act of selling a business or an industry so that it is no longer owned by the government

examples.x: There were fears that privatization would lead to job losses.

senses.definition_vi: hành động bán một doanh nghiệp hoặc ngành công nghiệp để nó không còn thuộc sở hữu của chính phủ nữa.

senses.definition: the money that you receive when you sell something or organize a performance, etc.; profits

examples.x: She sold her car and bought a piano with the proceeds.
The proceeds of the concert will go to charity.

senses.definition_vi: số tiền bạn nhận được khi bán một thứ gì đó hoặc tổ chức một buổi biểu diễn, v.v.; lợi nhuận.

senses.definition: things that have been made or grown, especially things connected with farming

examples.x: The market is full of farm produce.
The shop sells only fresh local produce.
It says on the label ‘Produce of France’.

senses.definition_vi: những thứ đã được làm ra hoặc trồng trọt, đặc biệt là những thứ liên quan đến nông nghiệp.

senses.definition: a thing that is grown, produced or created, usually for sale

examples.x: food/agricultural/software products
He has eliminated dairy products from his diet.
This product contains nuts.
The coating could appear in consumer products within five years.
The company sells its products around the world.
We are increasingly likely to buy products online.
Where did you purchase the product?
The cooperative helps local farmers successfully market their farm products.
It is the responsibility of the industry to produce safe products.
The company has been developing the product for years.
investment in product development
We have just launched a new product on to the market.
The store offers a wide range of products.
She was very happy with the finished product.
The bank offers a whole range of financial products and services.
We need new product to sell (= a new range of products).

senses.definition_vi: một thứ được trồng, sản xuất hoặc tạo ra, thường là để bán.

senses.definition: a thing produced during a natural, chemical or industrial process

examples.x: One product of any combustion reaction is carbon monoxide.
Methane is a product of this process.

senses.definition_vi: một thứ được tạo ra trong một quá trình tự nhiên, hóa học hoặc công nghiệp.

senses.definition: a person or thing that is the result of something

examples.x: The child is the product of a broken home.
Like many of his generation, he was a product of Japan's obsession with technology.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật là kết quả của một điều gì đó.

senses.definition: a cream or liquid that you put on your hair or skin to make it look better

examples.x: This product can be used on wet or dry hair.
Don’t put too much product on your skin.
Ken uses the very best styling products for Jessica's fine hair.

senses.definition_vi: một loại kem hoặc chất lỏng bạn bôi lên tóc hoặc da để làm cho nó trông đẹp hơn.

senses.definition: a quantity obtained by multiplying one number by another

examples.x: The product of 21 and 16 is 336.

senses.definition_vi: một số lượng thu được bằng cách nhân một số với một số khác.

senses.definition: the process of growing or making food, goods or materials, especially large quantities

examples.x: food/oil production
The new plant is due to begin production next year.
Production of the new aircraft will start next year.
The new model will be in production by the end of the year.
The car goes into production later this year.
This model went out of production last year.
production costs/processes
Prices have fallen below the cost of production.

senses.definition_vi: quá trình trồng trọt hoặc sản xuất thực phẩm, hàng hóa hoặc vật liệu, đặc biệt là số lượng lớn.

senses.definition: the quantity of goods that is produced

examples.x: a decline/an increase in production
The goal is to increase production by 40%.
Industries boosted production last month.
Production declined by 20%.
Production will drop by 60 000 next year.
It is important not to let production levels fall.
Market demand could outpace production capacity.

senses.definition_vi: số lượng hàng hóa được sản xuất.

senses.definition: the act or process of making something naturally

examples.x: Eating cheese stimulates the production of saliva.
Exposure to sunlight increases the production of melanin.
Green tea inhibits the production of this enzyme.

senses.definition_vi: hành động hoặc quá trình tạo ra một cái gì đó một cách tự nhiên.

senses.definition: a film, play or broadcast that is prepared for the public; the act of preparing a film, play, etc.

examples.x: a new production of ‘King Lear’
The college will be staging a production of 'The Wizard of Oz'.
Every year the school puts on a musical production.
He wants a career in film production.
Series four is currently in production.
The film goes into production next year.

senses.definition_vi: một bộ phim, vở kịch hoặc chương trình phát sóng được chuẩn bị cho công chúng; hành động chuẩn bị một bộ phim, vở kịch, v.v.

senses.definition: when you show something

examples.x: Discounts only on production of your student ID card.

senses.definition_vi: khi bạn giới thiệu một cái gì đó

senses.definition: the money that you make in business or by selling things, especially after paying the costs involved

examples.x: annual/pre-tax/corporate profits
Profits before tax grew from £615m to £1 168m.
a rise/an increase/a jump/a drop/a fall in profits
to maximize/increase profits
to report/post profits of £50 million
The club may turn a profit (= make a profit) by the end of the year.
The sale generated record profits.
Net profit (= after you have paid costs and tax) was up 16.1 per cent.
The business recorded a gross profit of (= before you pay costs and tax) £1.45 million last year.
The division's profit margins are being squeezed.
The directors are driven only by the profit motive.
The company made a healthy profit on the deal.
Profit from exports rose 7.7 per cent.
The radio station earns a profit from its advertising.
There was little or no profit in the products themselves.
There isn’t much profit in running a restaurant these days.
We should be able to sell the house at a huge profit.
The agency is voluntary and not run for profit.

senses.definition_vi: số tiền bạn kiếm được trong kinh doanh hoặc bằng cách bán mọi thứ, đặc biệt là sau khi đã trừ đi các chi phí liên quan

senses.definition: the advantage that you get from doing something

examples.x: Future lawyers could study this text with profit.

senses.definition_vi: sự thuận lợi mà bạn nhận được từ việc làm một điều gì đó

senses.definition: that makes or is likely to make money

examples.x: a highly profitable business
a profitable investment
It is usually more profitable to sell direct to the public.

senses.definition_vi: kiếm được hoặc có khả năng kiếm được tiền

senses.definition: that gives somebody an advantage or a useful result

examples.x: a profitable experience
She spent a profitable afternoon in the library.

senses.definition_vi: mang lại cho ai đó một lợi thế hoặc một kết quả hữu ích

senses.definition: an estimate or a statement of what figures, amounts, or events will be in the future, or what they were in the past, based on what is happening now

examples.x: to make forward/backward projections of population figures
Sales have exceeded our projections.
Calculations are based on a projection of existing trends.

senses.definition_vi: ước tính hoặc tuyên bố về các số liệu, số lượng hoặc sự kiện sẽ xảy ra trong tương lai, hoặc đã xảy ra trong quá khứ, dựa trên những gì đang diễn ra hiện tại

senses.definition: the act of putting an image of something onto a surface; an image that is shown in this way

examples.x: the projection of three-dimensional images on a computer screen
laser projections

senses.definition_vi: hành động chiếu hình ảnh của một cái gì đó lên một bề mặt; một hình ảnh được hiển thị theo cách này

senses.definition: a solid shape or object as represented on a flat surface

examples.x: map projections

senses.definition_vi: một hình dạng hoặc vật thể rắn được biểu diễn trên một bề mặt phẳng

senses.definition: something that sticks out from a surface

examples.x: tiny projections on the cell

senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó nhô ra từ một bề mặt

senses.definition: the act of making your voice, a sound, etc. audible (= able to be heard) at a distance

examples.x: voice projection

senses.definition_vi: hành động làm cho giọng nói, âm thanh, v.v. của bạn có thể nghe được ở xa

senses.definition: the act of imagining that somebody else is thinking the same as you and is reacting in the same way
senses.definition_vi: hành động tưởng tượng rằng người khác cũng nghĩ giống bạn và phản ứng theo cùng một cách

senses.definition: the act of giving a form and structure to inner thoughts and feelings

examples.x: The idea of God is a projection of humans' need to have something greater than themselves.

senses.definition_vi: hành động mang lại hình thức và cấu trúc cho những suy nghĩ và cảm xúc bên trong

senses.definition: to help sell a product, service, etc. or make it more popular by advertising it or offering it at a special price

examples.x: The band have gone on tour to promote their new album.
This trade fair will help businesses from Malawi to promote their products.
The area is being promoted as a tourist destination.

senses.definition_vi: giúp bán một sản phẩm, dịch vụ, v.v. hoặc làm cho nó trở nên phổ biến hơn bằng cách quảng cáo hoặc cung cấp nó với giá đặc biệt

senses.definition: to help something to happen or develop

examples.x: to promote democracy/peace/understanding/health
I applaud his efforts to promote world peace.
to promote the development/use of something
policies to promote economic growth
a campaign to promote awareness of environmental issues
The exhibition was intended to promote interest in contemporary sculpture.
We think football can help to promote the idea of a multicultural and multiethnic society.
Vietnam has actively promoted foreign investment.

senses.definition_vi: giúp một cái gì đó xảy ra hoặc phát triển

senses.definition: to move somebody to a higher rank or more senior job

examples.x: She worked hard and was soon promoted.
He has been promoted to sergeant.
He was an experienced officer who had been promoted from the ranks.

examples.cf: promote somebody from something to something
examples.x: She was promoted from finance director to chief executive.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển ai đó lên một cấp bậc cao hơn hoặc một vị trí cấp cao hơn

senses.definition: to move a sports team from playing with one group of teams to playing in a better group

examples.x: They were promoted to the First Division last season.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển một đội thể thao từ hạng đấu này sang hạng đấu tốt hơn

senses.definition: a move to a more important job or rank in a company or an organization

examples.x: The new job is a promotion for him.
Her promotion to Sales Manager took everyone by surprise.
a job with excellent promotion prospects

senses.definition_vi: việc chuyển lên một công việc hoặc cấp bậc quan trọng hơn trong một công ty hoặc tổ chức

senses.definition: a move by a sports team from playing in one group of teams to playing in a better group

examples.x: the team’s promotion to the First Division

senses.definition_vi: việc một đội thể thao chuyển từ thi đấu ở nhóm này sang thi đấu ở nhóm tốt hơn

senses.definition: activities done in order to increase the sales of a product or service; a set of advertisements for a particular product or service

examples.x: Her job is mainly concerned with sales and promotion.
We are doing a special promotion of French cheeses.
We're doing a major book promotion at key bookshops this week.

senses.definition_vi: các hoạt động được thực hiện để tăng doanh số bán sản phẩm hoặc dịch vụ; một loạt quảng cáo cho một sản phẩm hoặc dịch vụ cụ thể

senses.definition: activity that encourages people to believe in the value or importance of something, or that helps something to succeed

examples.x: a society for the promotion of religious tolerance
The new health promotion clinic will provide free check-ups.

senses.definition_vi: hoạt động khuyến khích mọi người tin vào giá trị hoặc tầm quan trọng của một điều gì đó, hoặc giúp một điều gì đó thành công

senses.definition: the possibility that something will happen

examples.x: There is no immediate prospect of peace.
They faced the prospect of defeat in the elections.
There was insufficient evidence for a realistic prospect of conviction.
It's a move that raises the prospect of a takeover battle for the airline.
Her family is having to come to terms with the increasingly unlikely prospect of ever finding her.
There's a reasonable prospect that his debts will be paid.
A place in the semi-finals is in prospect (= likely to happen).

senses.definition_vi: khả năng một điều gì đó xảy ra

senses.definition: an idea of what might or will happen in the future

examples.x: an exciting prospect
Travelling alone around the world is a daunting prospect.
Her heart sank at the prospect of marriage to a man she loathed.
The prospect of becoming a father filled him with alarm.
I don't relish the prospect of having to share an office.
I'm very excited at the prospect of joining the team.

senses.definition_vi: ý tưởng về những gì có thể hoặc sẽ xảy ra trong tương lai

senses.definition: the chances of being successful

examples.x: good job/employment/career prospects
industries with excellent growth prospects
At 25 he was an unemployed musician with no prospects.
Long-term prospects for the economy have improved.
The war undermines future prospects for economic growth.
Their prospects of success are slight.
What are the prospects of promotion in this job?
We are highly optimistic about the future prospects of the company.

senses.definition_vi: khả năng thành công

senses.definition: a person who is likely to be successful in a competition or in a particular career

examples.x: She is one of Canada's best prospects for a gold medal.
a list of the hot new prospects on the literary scene

senses.definition_vi: một người có khả năng thành công trong một cuộc thi hoặc trong một sự nghiệp cụ thể

senses.definition: a wide view of an area of land, etc.

examples.x: a delightful prospect of the lake

senses.definition_vi: một cái nhìn rộng về một khu vực đất đai, v.v.

senses.definition: expected to do something or to become something

examples.x: a prospective buyer
I had a phone call from a prospective client today.

senses.definition_vi: được kỳ vọng sẽ làm điều gì đó hoặc trở thành điều gì đó

senses.definition: expected to happen soon

examples.x: They are worried about prospective changes in the law.
On learning of a prospective sale, the lawyer should call the client as soon as possible.

senses.definition_vi: được kỳ vọng sẽ xảy ra sớm

senses.definition: the state of being successful, especially in making money

examples.x: Our future prosperity depends on economic growth.
The country is enjoying a period of peace and prosperity.

senses.definition_vi: trạng thái thành công, đặc biệt là trong việc kiếm tiền

senses.definition: the attention that is given to somebody/something by newspapers, television, etc.

examples.x: good/bad/adverse publicity
There has been a great deal of publicity surrounding his disappearance.
The trial took place amid a blaze of (= a lot of) publicity.

senses.definition_vi: sự chú ý mà báo chí, truyền hình, v.v. dành cho ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: the business of attracting the attention of the public to something/somebody; the things that are done to attract attention

examples.x: She works in publicity.
There has been a lot of advance publicity for her new film.
publicity material
a publicity campaign
The band dressed up as the Beatles as a publicity stunt.
He’s in charge of the publicity for next year’s festival.

senses.definition_vi: ngành kinh doanh thu hút sự chú ý của công chúng đến một điều gì đó/ai đó; những gì được thực hiện để thu hút sự chú ý

senses.definition: the act or process of buying something

examples.x: to make a purchase (= buy something)
Keep your receipt as proof of purchase.
The company would not reveal the original purchase price of the stores.
Many developers were delaying the purchase of land until later in the year.
The company has just announced its £27 million purchase of Park Hotel.
An illustrated catalogue is available for purchase.
Our intention is to increase purchases from local suppliers.
Such massive purchases by single investors were extremely rare.

senses.definition_vi: hành động hoặc quá trình mua một cái gì đó

senses.definition: something that you have bought

examples.x: major purchases, such as a new car
Figures suggest that consumers return one in five online purchases.
If you are not satisfied with your purchase we will give you a full refund.

senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó bạn đã mua

senses.definition: a strong hold on something with the hands or feet, for example when you are climbing

examples.x: She tried to get a purchase on the slippery rock.

senses.definition_vi: sự giữ chặt một cái gì đó bằng tay hoặc chân, ví dụ khi bạn đang leo trèo
